findings.observation: Verbatim: "const earlier = pick % (extra + 1);" and "const later = earlier + (pick % (extra - earlier + 1));". Both positions come from one pick, so the generated pairs are correlated rather than two independent draws. The properties still hold, and they fail under a non-monotonic rule, so the defect is coverage breadth only.
findings.remediation: Draw the two positions as independent generated values (for example fc.tuple(fc.nat(), fc.nat()) mapped into the range), keeping later >= earlier.
